title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is used to improve the reasoning abilities of LLMs, while training data span heterogeneous tasks. However, most RL post-training pipelines rely on fixed or manually designed task mixtures, even though task usefulness changes as training progresses. Online curriculum methods often define learnability by update magnitude, ignoring whether the update translates into reward gains, which can misallocate rollout budget toward tasks with large but ineffective updates. We propose PAC, a Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for multi-task RL of LLMs that combines two task-level signals: advantage-derived learnability, which measures the magnitude of the policy update a task can induce, and recent reward gains, which show whether those updates have improved task performance. A Bayesian Thompson Sampling controller uses these signals to allocate rollouts across tasks during GRPO training. We evaluate PAC under two set

translated_title: PAC：面向大语言模型多任务强化学习的进度增强优势课程学习方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）被用于提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，而训练数据涵盖异构任务。然而，大多数RL后训练流程依赖固定或手动设计的任务混合，即使任务的有用性会随着训练进程而变化。在线课程学习方法通常以更新幅度来定义可学习性，忽略了这些更新是否能转化为奖励提升，这可能导致将rollout预算错误地分配给那些更新幅度大但实际无效的任务。我们提出了PAC（Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum，进度增强优势课程），一种面向大语言模型多任务RL的方法，它结合了两个任务级信号：基于优势的可学习性（衡量一个任务能够引起的策略更新幅度）和近期奖励增益（表明这些更新是否真正提升了任务表现）。贝叶斯汤普森采样控制器利用这些信号在GRPO训练期间跨任务分配rollout。我们在两种设置下评估了PAC（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出PAC方法，通过结合优势可学习性与近期奖励增益两个信号，并利用贝叶斯汤普森采样在GRPO多任务训练中动态分配rollout预算，解决了现有课程学习方法将资源浪费在无效更新任务上的问题。
en_tdlr: PAC combines advantage-derived learnability with recent reward gains via a Bayesian Thompson Sampling controller to dynamically allocate rollouts across tasks during GRPO training, addressing the misallocation of rollout budgets toward tasks with large but ineffective updates.
